requirements.name: Antrag auf Anerkennung (equivalency assessment)
requirements.detail: Apply to the authority in the federal state where you will work; submit certified copies + German translations of diploma, transcripts, CV. Authority compares training to the German standard (Pflegeberufegesetz, PflBG).

requirements.name: German language B2 (CEFR) + Fachsprachprüfung
requirements.detail: B2 general German plus a specialist medical language examination (Fachsprachprüfung). Entry possible at A2/B1 under a Recognition Partnership (since 1 Mar 2024), full licence needs B2.

requirements.name: Police clearance + health suitability
requirements.detail: Impeccable police clearance certificate (Führungszeugnis) and proof of health suitability (Section 2 PflBG).

requirements.name: Adaptation course or knowledge test (Anpassungslehrgang / Kenntnisprüfung) — if deficits
requirements.detail: If the equivalency check finds gaps (Defizitbescheid — ~85% of non-EU applicants), complete an adaptation period or pass a knowledge test to close them. Conditional on the outcome of step 1.

requirements.name: Erlaubnis zum Führen der Berufsbezeichnung (licence to use the title)
requirements.detail: Authority grants the professional licence (Approbation/Berufserlaubnis as Pflegefachperson) once equivalency, language, conduct and any adaptation are satisfied. Decision within ~3-4 months of a complete file.
depends_on: Adaptation course or knowledge test (Anpassungslehrgang / Kenntnisprüfung) — if deficits

notes: EU/EEA/Swiss qualifications follow a different (faster) route. Responsible authority and exact language rule vary by Bundesland. Recognition Partnership (Mar 2024) lets applicants enter at A2 and finish while working.
